subtopic: ANSI SQL Isolation Levels (Read Committed to Serializable)
question_text: What is the 'Write Skew' anomaly in snapshot isolation (Repeatable Read)?

options.text: Two transactions read overlapping data sets, satisfy an invariant, but make disjoint writes that together violate the global integrity constraint
A transaction writes to a table while another drops it
A transaction reads dirty data from an uncommitted transaction
A transaction overwrites another transaction's committed write without reading it

answer_explanation: Example: Two doctors on call both check if at least one doctor remains active. Both see 2 active, both request leave concurrently and write their own status to inactive. Now 0 doctors are on call.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: A. Rationale: Example: Two doctors on call both check if at least one doctor remains active. Both see 2 active, both request leave concurrently and write their own status to inactive. Now 0 doctors are on call.
